Jonathan Berry has just been nominated to a powerful federal position—and hardly anyone is talking about how significant this is for Christians. But when you connect the dots between his nomination, recent global worship mandates, and new religious freedom legislation… a prophetic picture begins to emerge.

The Bible warned us to watch for forced worship, global unity in the name of peace, and counterfeit systems that look Christian but aren't. Revelation paints a clear warning about an end-time power that will appear lamb-like yet speak like a dragon.

This video dives into the latest Sunday law update, discusses the antichrist system, and explains why millions of sincere Christians may unknowingly be swept into something they never saw coming, including Revelation's mark of the beast.
